scope: Pre-frozen exploratory cohort; no candidate replacement, no population quantum success claim. Target/seed assignment is matched across policies but not independently crossed.
protocol: PBE0/def2-TZVP/DF(def2-universal-jkfit), grid3, SCF1e-8; input-geometry singlepoints only; distinct from source FHI-aims Tier2/PBE-TS.

selection.selection: Paired fixed policies; top DPA-ranked export and fixed SHA256 draw from remaining exports. No quantum or independent-model score used.
